title: The King of Babylon at the Crossroads
description: The prophet Ezekiel is commissioned to draw two paths that the sword of the king of Babylon may take, with a signpost where the roads split—one toward Rabbah in the land of Ammon and one toward Judah and Jerusalem. The king of Babylon stands at the crossroads seeking an omen by shaking arrows, consulting household gods, and examining the liver. The lot falls on Jerusalem, where he will set up siege ramps and lay siege to the city. The people see it as a false omen, but the Lord reminds them of their guilt, and judgment also strikes the ungodly prince of Israel, who must remove his turban and crown.
